semester_resolution_logic: Backend queries the Semester collection using the provided semesterCode (e.g. '3-2') to retrieve the academicSemesterId, and uses it to strictly filter SemesterResult records.

verifications.year_2_verification: Verified Year 2 CTPO (e.g. 25KTCSM) receives 0 results for 1-1, and 0 for no semesterCode.
verifications.year_4_verification: Verified Year 4 CTPO (e.g. 23KTCSM) has accurate assigned scope enforcing and fetching.
verifications.3-2_official_result_verification: Successfully verified that selecting 3-2 returns exactly 957 official records for the specific branch of the CTPO user (23KTCSM / CSM Branch), out of the 3916 total for the entire year.
verifications.unavailable_semester_verification: Selecting an unavailable semester like 1-1 immediately triggers the fallback 'No official university result data available for this semester.'
verifications.ctpo_scope_verification: CTPO is strictly limited to their branch and year as dictated by CtpoAssignment. The backend ignores unauthorized semester or student queries.
verifications.performance_query_verification: Initial load now requests /api/ctpo/results without semesterCode, returning only the year. The frontend then requests the default semester (e.g. 3-2). Filtering is strictly done server-side, eliminating massive data payloads.
verifications.build_typecheck_result: npm run build (which includes tsc -b) completed successfully.
verifications.regression_result: No modifications were made to Student Results, HOD, Principal, or Coordinator modules.
